integrity: Theorem derived from explicit normalized equations; all-time assertion proved analytically. Exact rational checker is supplemental. Literature priority remains subject to independent review, especially unindexed earlier work.
scientific_limitations: Global adult-stage predator exclusion requires zero adult-prey carryover and inverse-linear escape for both predators; the exact positive equilibrium wedge additionally requires Beverton-Holt prey recruitment. No claim of persistence of the juvenile predator, equilibrium stability, convergence or finite-population stochastic validity.
title: Global exclusion and an exact coexistence wedge for inverse-linear stage-specific predation
